source: 722 He Knows
target: 722 Ipse Novit

source: In the basement of 19 Rue Scheer, Lumian encountered Mr. K.
target: In subterrania viae Scheer 19, Lumian domino K occurrit.

source: If he hadn’t witnessed Mr. K transform into flesh and blood to envelop Moran Avigny and subsequently suffer holy light damage from the Purifiers, Lumian wouldn’t have believed that the energetic, black-hooded man before him had recently infiltrated the Intis Republic’s Minister of Industry’s residence and carried out an assassination.
target: Nisi videret Domini K in carne et sanguine transformari, ut Moran Avigny complecteretur et deinde damnum luminis sancti a Purificatoribus passum esset, Lumian non credidisset illum virum energeticum, cum nigro cucullo vestito, ante se nuper in residenciam Ministri Industriae Reipublicae Intis subrepere atque caedem exsecutum fuisse.

source: “You’re back from the Southern Continent?” Mr. K’s voice was as deep and raspy as ever.
target: “Rediitne ex Continente Australi?” vox Domini K tam profunda atque asperrima, ut semper fuit, resonabat.

source: Instead of sitting in the red armchair, he stood directly in front of Lumian, in the shadows projected by the crystal chandelier.
target: Pro eo ut in sellā rubra sedens remaneret, statim ante Luminum stetit, in umbris a crystallo candelabro proiectis.

source: Lumian didn’t hide anything and smiled.
target: Lumian nihil celavit et subridens erat.

source: “I’m back to do a favor for a friend. I’ll be leaving again in the future. As you know, I can teleport.”
target: “Redii ut amico benefaciam praestem; mox iterum discedam. Sicut scis, teleportare possum.”

source: Mr. K’s expansive hood swayed gently, as if nodding.
target: Cucullus vastus Domini K leniter fluctuat, quasi annuens.

source: He said with relief, “The fact that you still remember to come here and praise the Lord’s glory after returning to Trier proves I didn’t misjudge you.”
target: Ille cum solacio dixit: “Quod adhuc meministi huc venire et laudem gloriae Domini post reditionem ad Trier, demonstrat me non te male aestimavisse.”

source: Lumian, having just completed the prayer process with Mr. K, felt guilty and ashamed.
target: Lumian, modo cum Domino K orationem perfecisse, se culpam et erubescere sensit.

source: He cut to the chase.
target: Ad rem pervenit.

source: “I saw you assassinate Moran Avigny.”
target: “Te vidi Moran Avigny interficere.”

source: Under his hood, Mr. K’s gaze suddenly took on a tangible quality, and the shadows around him flickered.
target: Sub cucullo eius, aspectus Domini K subito efficiebatur substantiam tangibilem, et umbrae circa eum micare coeperunt.

source: After a few seconds, the Aurora Order Oracle asked in a hoarse voice, “You were there?”
target: Post paucos secundos, Oraculus Ordinis Aurorae voce rauca rogavit: “Adfuisti?”

source: Lumian maintained a relaxed demeanor as he replied.
target: Lumian habitu placido servatus respondit:

source: “Yes.”
target: “Ita.”

source: “Your assassination method bore the hallmarks of a Rose Bishop and was suspected of using Grazing to teleport.”
target: “Methodus interficendi tua insignia Episcopi Rosae portabat et suspicabatur te 'Grazing' ad teleportandum usurum esse.”

source: “Even with just the Purifiers’ information, it wouldn’t be hard for me to guess it was you.”
target: “Etiam ex sola notitia Purificatorum mihi non esset difficile coniectare te id fuisse.”

source: “But I admit, I was indeed present.”
target: “Sed fateor, re vera adfuisse me.”

source: “Where were you hiding?”
target: “Ubi te latebas?”

source: Lumian replied with a smile, “In the mirror Moran Avigny fled into.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: “In speculo quo Moran Avigny effugit.”

source: At this, Mr. K’s black robe fluttered despite the still air, as if countless flesh and blood were cheering beneath.
target: Ad hoc, toga nigra Domini K, non obstante quiescenti aere, volitabat, quasi innumerabiles carnes et sanguis subter exsultationem fecerint.

source: Unable to hide his excitement, he asked, “And now? Have you captured Moran Avigny?”
target: Excitationem celare non valens, rogavit: “Et nunc? Ceperisne Moran Avigny?”

source: “Yes.”
target: “Ita.”

source: Lumian nodded solemnly.
target: Lumian solemniter annuit.

source: “Hahaha! Hahaha!” Mr. K half-raised his body, revealing his thin chin, and erupted into maniacal laughter.
target: “Hahaha! Hahaha!” Domini K, dimidium corporis attollens et tenuem mentum patefaciens, insanam risum effudit.

source: His laughter made Lumian’s ears ring.
target: Risus eius auribus Luminum resonare fecit.

source: Light and shadows danced in the basement, the stench of blood permeating the air.
target: Lux et umbrae in subsolo saltaverunt, dum odor sanguinis aerem pervasit.

source: Finally, Mr. K stopped laughing and spoke with unnerving fanaticism,
target: Denique, Domini K risus cessavit et cum fanatico fervore locutus est:

source: “Just as the Lord arranged. Piousness is indeed the only way out!”
target: “Sicut Dominus ordinavit. Pietas certe sola via effugiendi est!”

source: He began tracing a cross on his chest.
target: Crucem in pectore suo delineare coepit.

source: “Praise you for creating all. Praise you for bearing the world’s sins!”
target: “Laudo te pro omnibus creatis. Laudo te pro mundi peccata ferendis!”

source: Lumian also praised the Aurora Order’s True Creator.
target: Lumian etiam Verum Creatorem Ordinis Aurorae laudavit.

source: Mr. K smiled and sighed.
target: Domini K subridit et suspiravit.

source: “I had planned to assassinate Moran Avigny in the coming days, but hadn’t set a date. However, when I saw him at the window this evening, gazing at the distant scenery, I sensed something off about his emotional state.
target: “Planiaveram interficere Moran Avigny in diebus venturis, sed diem non constitueram. Sed cum eum hac vespera ad fenestram vidi, longinqua conspectu intuens, aliquid perturbatum in affectibus eius mihi apparuit.”

source: “Fearing something might go wrong, I hastily launched the operation and failed.
target: “Ne quid malum eveniret metuens, festinanter operationem initiavi et defeci.”

source: “I was about to repent to the Lord and shoulder my sins when you arrived and told me you had captured Moran Avigny.
target: “Paene me Dominum paenitire ac peccata mea subire paratus eram, cum advenisti et dixeris te Moran Avigny ceperisse.”

source: “What does this signify?
target: “Quid hoc significat?”

source: “It means the Lord has prearranged everything. We need only pray, act, and do things with devotion. Nothing else matters.
target: “Hoc significat Dominus omnia praeordinasse; solum orare, agere atque cum devotione omnia facienda sunt; nihil aliud refert.”

source: “With piousness, failure is a stepping stone to success. Without it, even success leads to failure.”
target: “Pietate, defectus gradus ad prosperitatem est; sine ea etiam prosperitas in defectum ducit.”

source: In previous conversations with Mr. K, Lumian had always felt a language barrier.
target: In colloquiis prioribus cum Domino K, Lumian semper sensum obstaculi linguae perceptus erat.

source: He understood the words but couldn’t truly grasp the fanatical state.
target: Verba intellexit, sed statum fanaticum vere comprehendere non potuit.

source: But this time, his heart raced and a chill ran down his spine.
target: Sed hoc tempore, cor eius vehementer pulsavit et frigus per spinam eius decurrit.

source: Could the Under the Table transaction I initiated through the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction be connected to the Aurora Order’s Lord?
target: Possitne transactio sub mensa, quam per transactionem sub mensa tenentis auctoritatem incepit, ad Dominum Ordinis Aurorae coniungi?

source: Is that why Moran Avigny suddenly risked leaving through the study mirror?
target: Numquid ideo Moran Avigny subito per speculum studii discedere ausus est?

source: Why he came to the study to assess the environment, weighing the risks as he feigned reading…
target: Cur ad studium accessit ut ambitum perscruteret, pericula ponderans dum legere simulabat…

source: So, after I compelled Moran Avigny’s fate, Mr. K hurried to the study to assassinate him, forcing him to flee to the nearest mirror—the full-body one we hid in…
target: Itaque, postquam fatum Moran Avigny compellui, Domini K ad studium festinavit ut eum interficeret, coegens eum ut ad proximum speculum—illum totum corporis speculum in quo abscondimus—fugeret.

source: During the transaction, we paid with the Blood Gold ring, derived from the Beyonder characteristic of a Sequence 6 Rose Bishop of the Secrets Suppliant pathway…
target: Durante transactione, solvimus cum anulo Aureo Sanguinis, qui ex proprietate Beyonder Sequenciae VI Episcopi Rosae viae Secretorum Supplicantium deductus erat.

source: Lumian chose to share his feelings with Mr. K but concealed his fear and the power of Compelling Fate.
target: Lumian statuit affectus suos cum Domino K communicare, sed metum ac potentiam Fati Coercentis celavit.

source: He attributed all the developments to the Authority Holder’s Under‐the‐table Transaction.
target: Omnia eventa transactioni sub mensa a tenente auctoritate imputavit.

source: Despite his frenzied laughter, Mr. K remained composed.
target: Quamquam risus eius insanus erat, Domini K tranquillitatem servavit.

source: Solemnly and fanatically, he said, “The Lord watches, the Lord listens, and the Lord knows.”
target: Solemniter et fanatice, dixit: “Dominus videt, Dominus audit, et Dominus novit.”

source: Lumian had heard Madam Magician say similar words before but hadn’t felt their weight.
target: Lumian antea verba similia a Domina Maga audiverat, sed pondus illorum non sensit.

source: He hadn’t even been troubled, knowing it was futile.
target: Ne quidem perturbatus est, cum noverit id esse vanum.

source: But now, every hair on his body stood on end, a chill running down his spine.
target: At nunc, omnis capillus in corpore eius erectus est, et frigus per spinam eius decurrit.

source: He sensed eyes watching him from every shadow.
target: Animadvertit oculos ex singulis umbris eum intuentibus.

source: The more he experienced and learned, the more acutely he felt the terror and oppression of those three short sentences.
target: Quo plura experiebatur atque cognoscebat, eo acutius terrorem atque oppressionem trium brevium sententiarum sentiebat.

source: After a few seconds, Lumian praised the True Creator again and asked,
target: Post paucos secundos, Lumian iterum Verum Creatorem laudavit et quaesivit:

source: “Mr. K, why did you assassinate Moran Avigny? My friends and I dealt with him because the real Moran Avigny is dead. The active one is a Mirror Person. What about you?”
target: “Domine K, cur Moran Avigny interficisti? Amici mei et ego eum tractavimus, quoniam verus Moran Avigny mortuus est. At ille, qui nunc agit, est persona speculi. Et tu?”

source: “Mirror Person? No wonder he has Mirror Substitution. That’s precisely what I didn’t anticipate—causing the assassination to fail,” Mr. K sighed with realization.
target: “Persona speculi? Non mirum est quod substitutionem speculi habeat. Id ipsum prorsus quod non praevidi—causans ut interfectio deficeret,” Domini K cum intellectione suspiravit.

source: Pacing back and forth, he told Lumian,
target: Circumambulatione, Lumian inquit:

source: “Recent cases in Intis have led to an organization called the School of Truth.
target: “Casu recentibus in Intis duxerunt ad institutionem, quae Schola Veritatis appellatur.

source: They used degenerates from cults and official organizations to achieve certain goals.
target: Degeneratos ex cultibus et officiis organizationibus ad certos fines assequendos adhibuerunt.

source: For example, a descendant of Poli vanished mysteriously, and closely monitored pages from Roselle’s diary disappeared.
target: Exempli gratia, progenies Poli arcano modo evanuit, et paginae ex diario Rosella diligenter observatae evanuerunt.

source: Poli? One of Emperor Roselle’s Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse? A descendant of his has vanished?
target: Poli? Unus ex quattuor equitibus Apocalyptici Imperatoris Rosellae? Progenies eius evanuit?

source: Lumian’s eyelids twitched at the thought.
target: Palpebrae Luminum in cogitatione trepidaverunt.

source: Jebus Lata had mentioned the School of Truth’s three goals: finding clues about the fallen heaven, Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum, and 0-05, the Magic Wishing Lamp.
target: Jebus Lata tria proposita Scholae Veritatis enumeraverat: signa de caelo lapso invenienda, mausoleum finale Imperatoris Rosellae, et 0-05, Lampada Magica Optandi.

source: The Fourth Epoch Trier’s seal had just been breached.
target: Sigillum Quartae Epochae Trieris modo violatum erat.

source: For now, Intis’s official organizations were unlikely to overlook anything.
target: Ad hoc, organizationes officiales Intis, pro praesenti, nihil praetermittere arbitrabantur.

source: As for 0-05, Emperor Roselle’s eldest daughter Bernadette held it.
target: Quod ad 0-05 attinet, Bernadetta, filia maior Imperatoris Rosellae, eam habebat.

source: The School of Truth admitted they couldn’t handle the Element Dawn leader yet.
target: Schola Veritatis agnovit se ducem Elementi Aurorae nondum posse regere.

source: They wanted more boons before trying.
target: Plura dona voluerunt, priusquam conarentur.

source: In other words, two of the three targets required long-term planning from the School of Truth.
target: In aliis verbis, duo ex tribus propositis diuturnum consilium Scholae Veritatis requirebant.

source: That left clues about Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum.
target: Quae reliquae erant, indicia de mausoleo finali Imperatoris Rosellae relinquebantur.

source: Jebus mentioned having no relevant clues himself.
target: Jebus memoravit se nullas indicias pertinentes habuisse.

source: Whether the Overseer did was uncertain.
target: Utrum Praefectus id habuerit, incertum erat.

source: Combined with Mr. K’s account, Lumian had a bad feeling.
target: Cum narratione Domini K, Lumian pessimum premonitionem habebat.

source: Could the School of Truth already possess crucial clues about Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum?
target: Possitne Schola Veritatis iam indicia crucialia de mausoleo finali Imperatoris Rosellae possidere?

source: Mr. K continued, “We’re investigating these matters, as is Element Dawn.
target: Domini K perrexit: “Has res investigamus, sicut Elementum Aurorae.

source: “We recently discovered Moran Avigny’s involvement in some cases.
target: “Nuper deprehendimus participationem Moran Avigny in nonnullis casibus.

source: He seemed to be a key figure in the School of Truth.”
target: Videbatur eum esse figuram clavem in Schola Veritatis.

source: “Then why assassinate him instead of capturing him?” Lumian felt Mr. K’s previous actions aimed to kill Moran Avigny.
target: “Cur ergo interficis eum potius quam capis?” Lumian sensit priores actiones Domini K ad caedem Moran Avigny intendisse.

source: Mr. K chuckled raspily.
target: Domini K rauce risit.

source: “Killing him is simpler than capture.
target: Eum interficere simplex est quam capere.

source: And after his death, an abnormality will undoubtedly occur.
target: Et post mortem eius, anomalia certissime occurret.

source: The official Beyonders will find a way to communicate with his spirit.
target: Beyonderi officiales viam reperient ad spiritum eius communicandum.

source: Then, the authorities will investigate the School of Truth to thwart their plan.
target: Deinde auctoritates Scholae Veritatis investigabunt ad consilium illorum impediendum.

source: Isn’t that our goal?
target: Nonne hoc nostrum propositum est?

source: Plus, we can shadow the authorities to track down School of Truth members.
target: Praeterea, auctoritates speculando, membra Scholae Veritatis detegere possumus.

source: You, an Aurora Order Oracle, have also learned to “report” and exploit the authorities?
target: Tu, Oraculus Ordinis Aurorae, etiam didicisti auctoritates referre et ex illis uti?

source: Lumian found it amusing.
target: Lumian id iocose invenit.

source: If not for needing more information about the Mirror People, he, Franca, and the others could have simply forced Moran Avigny to show signs of abnormality, avoiding so much trouble.
target: Nisi plura de Personis Speculi discenda essent, ille, Franca, et ceteri, facile Moran Avigny coacturi fuisset ut signa anomaliae ostenderet, ita multum incommodi vitantes.

source: Lumian delved into more details with Mr. K, increasingly sensing the School of Truth was close to locating Emperor Roselle’s final mausoleum.
target: Lumian cum Domino K in plura ingeniis delapsus est, magis magisque sensit Scholae Veritatis prope ad mausoleum finale Imperatoris Rosellae pervenire.

source: Without delay, he expressed his urgency to return and interrogate Moran Avigny to prevent mishaps.
target: Sine mora, urgentiam suam declaravit redire atque Moran Avigny interrobandum, ut casus vitaretur.

source: “Do you need my help?” Mr. K inquired.
target: “Opusne est tibi auxilio meo?” Dominus K rogavit.

source: Lumian responded with a smile, “Not for now. We have a Hypnotist, the Bliss Society’s truth serum, and a Demoness skilled in spirit channeling.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: “Non nunc. Habemus hypnoticum, serum veritatis Societatis Beatitudinis, et daemonissam peritam in ducendis spiritibus.”

source: He didn’t mention also having Fate Appropriator abilities.
target: Non memoravit etiam facultates Fati Appropriatoris habere.

source: During Fate Appropriation, Lumian could “see” all of Moran Avigny’s past and present fates, and most fate tributaries.
target: Durante Fati Appropriatione, Lumian videre poterat totum fatum Moran Avigny, tam praeteritum quam praesens, atque pleraque fata tributaria.

source: But the duration was limited, only allowing extraction of the most pertinent information.
target: Sed duratio restricta erat, sola extrahendi maxime pertinentes informationes permittens.

source: “Alright, let me know if you need anything.” Mr. K sized up Lumian with admiration.
target: “Bene, indica mihi si quid tibi opus est.” Dominus K Luminum cum admiratione aestimavit.

source: Finding a secluded spot to teleport back to the safe house, Lumian surveyed the area and said to Franca, “Use Mirror Cufflink’s ability to take us back to the underground quarry cave.”
target: Inveniens locum remotum ad teletransportandum ad domum tutam, Lumian regionem perlustrarem et Francae dedit: “Utere facultate ‘Mirror Cufflink’ ut nos ad speluncam subterraneam lapidariam redeas.”

source: This would prevent accidents from affecting the neighborhood.
target: Hoc praeveniret ne casus in vicinitatem afficerent.

source: Lumian had already teleported multiple times that day and even altered Moran Avigny’s fate.
target: Lumian iam plurimas volte illo die teletransportatus erat et fatum Moran Avigny etiam mutavit.

source: Previously, he had played the Symphony of Hatred and triggered a series of weakness assaults.
target: Priore tempore, symphoniam odii egit et seriem impetus infirmitatis provocavit.

source: The immense expenditure left him with spirituality for only seven to eight more teleports and no further accumulation.
target: Ingentes expensae eum reliquerunt cum solis septem vel octo teletransportationibus spiritualibus et nulla ulterius accumulatione.

source: In this situation, using Beyonder items when possible was only natural.
target: In hac condicione, uti rebus Beyonder, quot possunt, naturaliter eveniebat.

source: Understanding Lumian’s state, Franca didn’t hold back on the Mirror Cufflink’s charges.
target: Intellecta Luminum condicione, Franca de vectigalibus ‘Mirror Cufflink’ nihil remisit.

source: She only asked Lumian to carry the colossal dog and keep it from touching her.
target: Sola petivit a Luminum ut canem ingentem portaret et ne eum attingeret.

source: She then made the glass cufflink on her blouse glow, leading Lumian and the others into the room’s mirror.
target: Deinde efficivit ut vitreus cufflink in veste sua fulgeret, ducens Luminum et ceteros in speculum cubiculi.

source: Through the dark, empty tunnel, they appeared in the quarry cave with a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
target: Per tenebrosum et vacuum cuniculum apparuerunt in spelunca lapidea, cui ingressus ad mundum speculi fixus erat.

source: Franca took out the truth serum and tossed it to Anthony Reid with a friendly smile.
target: Franca serum veritatis extraxit et, subridens amabiliter, ad Anthoniam Reid coniecit.

source: “Feed some to Moran Avigny and have a good chat with him.”
target: “Trado aliquod ad Moran Avigny et bene cum eo colloquere.”
